fields.description: Flare is a two-tower apartment development in Jumeirah Village Triangle, with studios through four-bedroom homes and retail space. Curved balconies wrap its façades, while selected larger terraces contain private pools. This profile distinguishes Flare 01 and 02 rather than transferring a tower-specific layout or offer across both buildings.

overview: A terrace with a private pool is a different proposition from a regular apartment. Compare enclosed accommodation, outdoor space and the maintenance obligations of the exact home, rather than treating the largest headline size as interior living space.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai. The building and apartment orientation must be confirmed before assigning a view or access route.
research.priceNote: The own combined Flare project page displays FROM AED 800000. Property Finder’s Flare 01 launch reference is also 800,000 but marks that release sold out. A retained marketing minimum does not confirm a unit, tower allocation or present resale asking price.
research.paymentNote: The developer’s combined FAQ states 20% at signing, 50% during construction and 30% on completion. Property Finder separately lists Flare 01 alternatives 10/60/30 and 10/50/40. Each totals 100 but applies to a different published offer; the selected tower and unit’s written schedule is required.
research.handoverNote: The developer’s combined page targets Q2 2027, while Property Finder’s Flare 01 page gives July 2027/Q3 2027. The discrepancy is not silently resolved or applied to both towers. Obtain the current tower-specific contractual completion and handover notice.
